placements.why: src-1 establishes the weekday late-sailing curtailment from November, src-2 provides empirical passenger demand data justifying the reduction, and src-3 contrasts this with strong weekend ridership to maintain Friday and Saturday sailings.
placements.title: Curtailing Weekday Late Sailings to Match Low Ridership While Preserving Weekend Service
placements.frame: how should ferry sailing timetables be adjusted across weekdays and weekends in response to passenger ridership patterns?
